definitions.gloss: original intention; initial resolve; first aspiration
definitions.explanation: The intention or determination one had at the very beginning of an endeavor. Often used when discussing whether someone has stayed true to their original goals.

examples.japanese: {初志|しょし}{貫徹|かんてつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to follow through on your original intentions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{初志|しょし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: Even when facing difficulties, you must not forget your original resolve.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{初志|しょし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貫|つらぬ}いて→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧、{十年|じゅうねん}⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He stayed true to his original resolve and achieved his dream over ten years.

notes:
Most commonly encountered in the four-character idiom {初志|しょし}{貫徹|かんてつ} (carrying through one's original intention). Outside this set phrase, {初志|しょし} is used on its own to refer to one's initial aspirations or determination.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初志|しょし}{貫徹|かんてつ}: carrying through one's original intention (set phrase)
- {初志|しょし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貫|つらぬ}く→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧: to stick to one's original intention
- {初志|しょし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧: to not forget one's original resolve
- {初志|しょし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}げる→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧: to abandon one's original intention

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{初|しょ}→初〜：03955_sho⟧ (first, initial) + {志|し} (will, intention, aspiration).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{初心|しょしん}→初心：08656_shoshin⟧: beginner's mind, original spirit — broader; also used for 'beginner' (⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧) and the phrase ⟦{初心|しょしん}→初心：08656_shoshin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧ (to go back to basics)
- ⟦{志|こころざし}→志：06655_kokorozashi⟧: aspiration, ambition — more general; not limited to one's initial intention
